name: Carbon
fit: Dense product UI for tools and data.
principles: Neutral gray does the organizing. Color is for action and status. Productive screens stay compact. Expressive marketing type is a separate set.
color: Role tokens: background, layer, field, border, text, link, icon, support, focus, and skeleton. Light themes are White and Gray 10. Dark themes are Gray 90 and Gray 100.
typography: IBM Plex. Productive type is fixed, with a 14px body for dense UI. Expressive headings are fluid. Product weights are Light, Regular, and SemiBold.
spacing: Multiples of 2, 4, and 8, inside components and between them. A stack utility owns gaps so components do not carry margin.
elevation: Layer tokens do the stacking. In dark themes, surfaces lighten as they rise. In light themes, white and gray alternate. Shadow is secondary.
layout: The 2x Grid. The mini unit is 8px.
icons: IBM icon and pictogram sets, aligned to the icon color tokens.
components: Buttons, forms, data table, tabs, modal, notification, and structured list, including skeleton states. Patterns cover login, forms, and filtering.
themes: Four named themes. Changing the theme swaps the universal tokens. Components are not restyled one by one.
adapt: Keep the role tokens, the productive type scale, and the spacing tokens. Replace IBM Plex and IBM blue unless this product is that formal.
